V3.0 更新 - 使用最新版本的 ComfyUI 0.3.75！

我一直在学习如何制作简单而优雅的 ComfyUI 工作流程。我将其放在一起，以便可以选择使用基本模型和细化器模型，以及包含 FaceDetailer 节点来修复任何可疑的面孔。

我主要运行小马检查点，并且一直在使用此工作流程为我最近的 WAN i2v 视频生成起始图像。

查看我在使用此工作流程生成图像后使用的 WAN 2.2 i2v 工作流程：https://civitai.com/models/2194801/simple-wan-22-i2v-60-fps-video-comfyui-workflow-6-step-lightning-with-3-ksamplers-and-upscale

如果您使用它，请在您上传的图片中标记该工作流程。我不关心归属，我只是想看看其他人使用我制作的工具创建了什么:)这是我为自己做的，但我发现它很有用而且很漂亮，所以我想我会分享它！

非常感谢收到反馈。否则，享受吧。

o.en:
V3.0 Update - Working with the latest version of ComfyUI 0.3.75!

I've been learning how to make simple and elegant looking ComfyUI workflows. I put this one together to have the option of using a base model and a refiner model as well as including a FaceDetailer node to fix any dodgy faces.

I mostly run pony checkpoints and I have been using this workflow to generate the starting images for my recent WAN i2v videos.

Check out my WAN 2.2 i2v workflow that I use after generating images with this workflow:https://civitai.com/models/2194801/simple-wan-22-i2v-60-fps-video-comfyui-workflow-6-step-lightning-with-3-ksamplers-and-upscale

Please tag the workflow in your image uploads if you use it. I don't care about attribution, I just want to see what others are creating using the tool I made :)I made this for myself, but I find it useful and pretty so I thought I'd share it!

Feedback gratefully received. Otherwise, enjoy.
